# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 7 tokens; Text — 9 tokens; Borders and rings — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 29 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 4 tokens; Motion — 5 tokens; Font weight — 4 tokens; Line height — 2 tokens; Letter spacing — 2 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the default value */
```

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-text-display-xl);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-display-xl` | `.text-display-xl`, `--text-text-display-xl` | 52px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `text-display-l` | `.text-display-l`, `--text-text-display-l` | 38px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `text-heading` | `.text-heading`, `--text-text-heading` | 24px / 1.25 | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `text-subheading` | `.text-subheading`, `--text-text-subheading` | 18px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` |  |
